title: Airtel Mobile Money Gabon \u2013 Digital Financial Services Guarantee
description: MIGA political risk guarantee covering The Rise Fund II Aurora S.à r.l. (TPG private equity) equity investment in Airtel Mobile Commerce B.V.'s subsidiary providing Airtel Money digital financial services in Gabon. Services include mobile wallet (cash-in/cash-out), airtime recharging, bill payments, merchant payments; with international transfers, savings and microloans in some markets. Risks: war and civil disturbance, expropriation, transfer restriction and inconvertibility for up to 5 years.

title: Gabon Statistical Development Project
description: Strengthens statistical capacity of Gabon, fills key data gaps, improves statistical production, and enhances statistical dissemination practices. Supports national accounts modernization, welfare monitoring statistics, agricultural statistics, and dissemination platform development. Includes statistical agency infrastructure modernization and institutional reform of the national statistical system.
